summary: Phase F — Staff & Safeguarding testing complete. All 19 backend tests pass. Frontend verified: Instructor Roster view renders with Export payroll button, Payroll modal with date inputs and Download CSV button, Add instructor button opens editor drawer with 'Compliance & pay' tab containing all 9 safeguarding/payroll inputs (DBS reference/issued/expires, Safeguarding completed/expires, First aid completed/expires, Hourly rate, Substitute toggle).

integration_issues.issue: Login form submission doesn't redirect after successful API call - had to use localStorage token injection for testing. This may be a pre-existing issue unrelated to Phase F.

critical_code_review_comments: instructors.py: Static routes (/substitutes, /compliance, /payroll.csv) correctly declared BEFORE dynamic /{instructor_id} route to avoid shadowing
_compliance_status helper correctly computes traffic-light status (green/amber/red/missing) based on expiry dates with 60-day amber threshold
InstructorPatch model now includes all Phase F fields (dbs_reference, dbs_issued_on, dbs_expires_on, safeguarding_*, first_aid_*, hourly_rate_pence, substitute_available)
Payroll CSV endpoint validates date format and returns 400 for malformed dates
InstructorRosterView.js: All Phase F UI elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_PhaseF_Instructor and TEST_RouteShadow_Instructor during backend tests (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase F features verified: (1) GET /api/memberships/instructors/substitutes returns 200 with compliance object per row, respects ?specialty= and ?discipline= filters, (2) GET /api/memberships/instructors/compliance returns 200 with summary counts (green/amber/red/missing/total), (3) GET /api/memberships/instructors/payroll.csv returns text/csv with correct headers and TOTAL row, 400 for malformed dates, (4) POST/PATCH instructor accepts and persists all Phase F fields (dbs_*, safeguarding_*, first_aid_*, hourly_rate_pence, substitute_available), (5) Setting substitute_available=false hides instructor from /substitutes, (6) Regression: /performance and /{instructor_id} routes still work, (7) Frontend: Export payroll button opens modal with date inputs and Download CSV button, (8) Frontend: Add instructor drawer has 'Compliance & pay' tab with all 9 safeguarding/payroll inputs.
